title: The exact constant of the two-parameter Type II sieve for the Erdős–Straus equation: paper, Lean 4 formalization and verification code
description:
We prove that the sum W(J) of 1/phi(4ua) over coprime pairs u, a <= J equals (9/(2 pi^2))((log J + gamma + T)^2 + M) + O(J^{-1/2} log J) with explicit constants T and M. This sum governs the sieve of B. Dahan (arXiv:2608.24035) for the primes at which a depth-J search finds no Type II solution of the Erdős–Straus equation 4/n = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z; the leading constant is three times the one proved there, and it answers the first open question of that paper. The Erdős–Straus conjecture itself remains open.

preprintErdosStrausSieveConstant/ holds the paper; paper/ the LaTeX source with three figures; dist/ the PDF, the LaTeX zip and the arXiv tarball; lean/ a Lean 4 and Mathlib project checking the algebraic steps (axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound only); checks/ programs in C, C++, Python and Julia; scripts/run_all.sh runs everything.
